contentSection.heading: Our Product

items.description: Gold Finish Cabin is a design crafted to showcase your building’s elegance and opulence.

Add a touch of regal elegance to your building with our Gold Finish Cabin, designed for those who seek nothing but the finest. The cabin’s premium gold-tone stainless steel finish offers a rich, luxurious appeal that enhances the overall aesthetic of high-end residences, hotels, and commercial spaces. With sleek automatic doors, designer ceilings, and ambient lighting, this cabin turns every elevator ride into a premium experience.

contentSection.description: The Gold Finish Cabin is meticulously crafted with a full stainless steel golden finish enclosure, offering a brilliant shine and premium feel. It comes equipped with fully automatic centre-opening or telescopic doors, blending functionality with elegance.

items3.text: Full stainless steel golden finish for a brilliant, premium look
Fully automatic centre-opening or telescopic doors
Designer false ceilings with efficient lighting
Built-in blower for passenger comfort and ventilation
Mirror-polished gold finish adds depth and style

contentSection.description2: This model features high-resolution LED digital indicators on hall floors and plasma displays inside the cabin. Combined with square SS90 buttons and electronic door safety features, it ensures both ease of use and enhanced passenger security.

items4.text: High-resolution LED indicators on hall floors
Square SS90 buttons for easy operation
Electronic door safety features for security
